ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.05:0.95 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed fine-grained white stippling across both lobes; a localized diffuse light-gray geometric blob situated in the upper-medial region of the right lobe; high-intensity clusters localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate pixel angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations. Right lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and deep valleys (macro-notches) concentrated in the medial section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a smooth concave trailing edge trajectory; right lobe follows a complex, highly irregular convex-to-hooked trajectory at the distal extremity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, textured circular nodules (barnacles) localized on both the left and right distal tips; scattered white circular spots of 2-10 pixel diameter across the main fluke body.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A set of four distinct parallel, high-intensity linear marks (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the lower-medial region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant macro-scale tissue loss/irregularities along the trailing edge of the right lobe; heavy barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip exhibits a pronounced inward-curving 'hook' geometry heavily encrusted with high-contrast biological growth.
